item.title: Drake Hit With Third Lawsuit Over Stake, Accused Of Using Gambling Funds To Inflate Music Streams
item.description: Drake’s list of lawsuits continues to grow. The latest is a new RICO class-action filed in Virginia that names Drake, streamer Adin Ross, online casino Stake (Stake.us), and Australian clip farmer George Nguyen as defendants. The suit accuses them of using Stake’s platform to illegally finance the inflation of Drake’s music streaming numbers. item.title: Billy Joel Performs For The First Time Since Brain Disorder Diagnosis, Joining Tribute Band In Wellington, FL
item.description: In May of last year, Billy Joel canceled all of his shows due to normal pressure hydrocephalus, which is when cerebrospinal fluid builds up in your skull and presses on your brain. He later clarified that he was not dying, but he said his "balance sucks." Last night, the Piano Man performed for the first time since that diagnosis. item.title: Morrissey Sets First Concert Cancellations Of 2026
item.description: Morrissey loves to cancel shows. This has always been true, but it's especially true as of late. In September he canceled an Ottawa concert over a Bluesky threat, in October he axed a Turkey gig due to backlash over his support for Israel, in November he called off his South American tour because of "extreme exhaustion," and in December he inexplicably canceled his first-ever Dominican Republic concert. item.title: San Francisco Club Bottom Of The Hill Is Closing
item.description: San Francisco's beloved independent music venue Club Bottom Of The Hill has been around for 35 years, but it'll be closing at the end of 2026.
